blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — DMCI Homes has partnered with Pag-Ibig Fund to make up to 3,990 condominium units eligible for housing loan financing, subject to the completion of project accreditations. The property developer signed a memorandum of understanding with the state-run housing lender on Friday to broaden financing options for qualified buyers.
